questionText:
Which one of the following statements is not correct about the cultural
consequences of globalisation?

options.text:
The cultural effect of globalization leads to the fear that this process
poses a threat to cultures in the world.
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.

options.text:
The consequences of globalization is strictly confined to the sphere of
politics and economy.
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Accurately identifies the chronological/logical progression.

options.text: The rise of a uniform culture is not emergence of a global culture.
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.

options.text:
What we have in the name of global culture is the imposition of Western
culture on the rest of the world.
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
Cultural globalisation impacts food, attire, values, and music worldwide. Far from being confined to politics and economics, globalization exerts powerful cultural effects, creating both cultural homogenisation (spread of Western monoculture) and cultural heterogenisation (appropriation into local contexts). Thus, statement (C) is factually false.
Hence, option (B) is correct.

questionText: Which of the following statements regarding B.R. Ambedkar Party in Era of One-Party Dominance is INCORRECT / NOT true?

options.text: It conforms strictly to the standard equilibrium conditions defined in NCERT Era of One-Party Dominance.
options.mistakeAnalysis: This is a factually correct principle of NCERT and cannot be chosen as an incorrect statement.

options.text: It exhibits consistent and reproducible behavior across verified experimental measurements.
options.mistakeAnalysis: This is a factually correct principle of NCERT and cannot be chosen as an incorrect statement.

options.text: Its magnitude depends directly on the governing physical or analytical constants of B.R. Ambedkar Party.
options.mistakeAnalysis: This is a factually correct principle of NCERT and cannot be chosen as an incorrect statement.

options.text: It operates in direct violation of the fundamental conservation laws of Era of One-Party Dominance.
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Identifies the statement that contains a scientific falsehood.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
According to standard NCERT Era of One-Party Dominance specifications, B.R. Ambedkar Party is fully consistent with established principles and does not violate conservation laws.
Therefore, statement (D) is false, making it the correct answer to this negative constraint question.
